title: Eight personal traveler buttons
activation: public-assets.mjs publishes all eight canonical paths. The prepared personal-button items use these same paths; quest activation is a separate content change.
preservation: Generated originals are identified by generation ID and SHA-256. Runtime PNGs are uniform 1024px exports with alpha, followed by the standard stage/card WebP pipeline. Existing artwork is not re-encoded.

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: Cosyworld inventory sprite, 1024 by 1024 square.
Input image: edit target, the approved Vale wooden sewing button.
Primary request: create nell's matching button by changing ONLY the painted wooden body colour to warm mustard yellow, and the central cross stitch colour to soft lavender violet.
Keep the exact shape, slight angle, framing, recessed face, raised rim, four visible thread holes, diagonal wood grain, worn edges, painterly texture, lighting, and balanced composition. Preserve the natural exposed wood at chips and inside the holes. Keep all four holes visibly open around the stitch, and keep the stitch clearly separate from the wood.
Scene/backdrop: genuine fully transparent background and transparent open holes. No cast shadow or floor.
Constraints: one centered button, same generous transparent padding as reference, no text, no label, no extra objects, no border. Preserve the existing alpha silhouette. Soft painted storybook game-item art.
